quantities.delta_M: signed lifted PF energy minus lowest H Ritz energy

validity.C_C: t finite positive, abs(delta_C) finite and <epsilon_E, resulting C_C finite positive
validity.B0: same checks at T0; invalid baseline stops condition, no alternative anchor

B1.gamma_semantics: continuous budget multiplier, not proxy-error multiplier
B1.eligible: t>T0 AND A_eta(t)>0 AND finite positive B_gamma(t)<=0.90*B0
B1.selection: minimum budget among eligible; exact budget tie smaller t, then candidate_id
B1.no_eligible: fallback (T0,B0), including gamma 1.02/1.05/1.10 arms; no gamma-specific anchor change

M1.abstain: inherited numerical/branch failure, requested primary unavailable, or nonfinite e_use or e_use>=epsilon_E
M1.eligible: t>T0 AND A_eta>0 AND not abstaining AND e_use<=A_eta
M1.selection: minimum frozen budget; exact budget tie smaller time then candidate_id; otherwise (T0,B0)

no_fit_spec.scope: secondary development diagnostic; new four-gamma data to be acquired under future authorization, not invented saved S1A frontier

B2.gamma_candidate_disagreement: nonfallback selected candidates are not identical across all four gamma arms
B2.gamma_eligibility_disagreement: eligible candidate sets or fallback status are not identical across all four gamma arms
B2.proxy_sign_instability: cap-exterior proxies contain both positive and negative signs or at least one indeterminate sign
B2.candidate_choice: minimum frozen continuous budget among eligible candidates; tie chooses smaller time; no eligible candidate falls back to inherited B0/T0

H1_acquisition.q_rule: q=1 iff cheap_instability is true or B2 uses baseline fallback; otherwise q=0
H1_acquisition.conditional_access: open saved M1 rows only for q=1 conditions

H1_final.M1_unusable: retain nonfallback B2; otherwise use B0
H1_final.if_B2_validated: choose smaller frozen quantum budget between nonfallback B2 and M1; numerical tie chooses B2

normalization.native_candidates: three H-chain ratios; do not pool HF/HCl native contracts
normalization.missing_frontier: invalid input/contract; do not fit or drop gamma
normalization.missing_or_abstaining_M1: use S1A M1_unusable rule; do not label spectral consistency pass

H1_data_availability_vs_access: M1 may later exist for all coordinates for always-M1 comparison. H1 must first freeze q from cheap-only data and open/acquire M1 only for q=1.
cost_status: combined path proposal requires review; saved-arm replay envelope is not measured combined cost
primary_outputs: per-system point error, width coverage, physical branch compatibility, safety, anchor extension and frozen-budget/cost frontiers; no new H-chain robust_signal taxonomy
